## Problem

Describe the user problem or production failure this change addresses.

## Change

Name the contract, behavior, or documentation that changed.

## Evidence

Link source documentation, sanitized fixtures, screenshots, or regression reports that support the change.

## Validation

- [ ] Portable skill validation passes in strict mode.
- [ ] Python repository tests pass.
- [ ] Comment-worker fixture tests pass when that service is affected.
- [ ] Claude Code plugin validation passes when plugin files are affected.
- [ ] New failure modes have a regression test or fixture.
- [ ] Markdown links resolve.
- [ ] The change contains no credentials, handles, integration IDs, publication URLs, analytics exports, or raw provider responses.

## Human gates

List rights, billing, credentials, account ownership, privacy, or ambiguous external mutations that remain human decisions. Write `None` only when the change has no external boundary.
